en.title: Gossip Girl and Deadwind Among October 2026 Netflix Departures
en.summary: Fans have just weeks to catch up on beloved series as Netflix prepares for a major content purge. Several fan-favorite shows and movies are exiting the platform next October, including major licensed hits and a popular Netflix Original.
en.body:
As the leaves turn and Halloween approaches, Netflix is clearing out its digital shelves, with October 2026 set to see a significant wave of titles depart the service. This annual content refresh means a prime opportunity for viewers to revisit or discover some massive licensed hits before they vanish.

Leading the charge on October 1st, expect to say goodbye to a slate of blockbuster movies and beloved classics. From Sony's **Spider-Man: Homecoming** and animated fun like **The Boss Baby** to essential teen comedy **Clueless** and the original **Ghostbusters**, movie nights will need careful planning. The situation is particularly stark for television aficionados, as several long-standing series are slated for removal. Prepare for the end of the line for binge-watch staples such as Showtime's **Shameless** and **Nurse Jackie**, alongside teen drama cornerstones **Dawson's Creek** and **Gossip Girl**. Adding to the list, the Finnish crime drama **Deadwind**, a Netflix Original, will also be leaving as its exclusive window closes.

## A Brutal Month for TV Fans

The departure of **Gossip Girl**, with all six seasons leaving on October 28th, and **Deadwind**, with its three seasons exiting on October 29th, represents a significant loss for fans of teen dramas and international crime thrillers respectively. These shows have been staples for many, offering complex character arcs and compelling narratives that fueled countless hours of viewing. The removal of **Gossip Girl** marks the end of an era for its devoted fanbase, who have followed the scandalous lives of Manhattan's elite for years. Similarly, **Deadwind**'s exit will leave a void for those who appreciate its gritty atmosphere and intricate plotting. While **Seinfeld** was initially slated for removal, Netflix has secured the rights for another five years, ensuring its continued presence. However, this does little to soften the blow for fans of the other departing series.

## What's Next

Beyond October, the content removals continue into November, with titles like **Paddington in Peru** and the first Universal live-action movies departing after their licensing periods conclude, including **M3GAN 2.0** on November 26th. As always, these lists are dynamic and subject to change, so checking back regularly is advised to ensure no favorite titles slip through the cracks unnoticed. New additions like **21 Jump Street** and **22 Jump Street** are expected to arrive, offering some fresh content amidst the departures.
